items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Early 60s with Chubby Checker. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Early sixties.

ctx.x: on the PA and pumped it into the auditorium to where the band was, right? And you know that’s what it was [scats]. If I couldn’t have memorized that in five seconds I deserved to be canned. So anyway Alan Funt says to Sid Raymond he says, “Sid, do you think you can write something along those lines?” And he says, “sure.” He says, “can you have it ready by the show?” He says, “we’ll need about 45 seconds. So he says sure. So he wrote two choruses of blues, and he says, “hey Sonny, do I have to write a part for…
